title: Recovery 1 - counting U1's pins (bottom and right edges)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)
caption: U1 is counted from its pin-1 dot (top-left, outside this picture) counter-clockwise: 17-32 left to right along the bottom edge, 33 upward on the right edge. The four highlighted toes are the ones chapter 1 touches.
